items.definition:
showing an affected interest in art
She has a very arty style of dressing.

relating to or involving the application of statistical analysis to biological data
The phone uses biometric security, like fingerprint recognition.

unpleasant or offensive
His comments were rather distasteful.

relating to Eurasia or people of European and Asian descent
The Eurasian landmass is the largest continental area on Earth.

outside the regular curriculum of a school or university
She participates in many extracurricular activities, like sports and clubs.

having a lot of flesh; plump or corpulent
The plant has thick, fleshy leaves.

relating to Greece or the Greeks
The museum displayed many Greco-Roman artifacts.

beyond comparison; matchless
Her talent was incomparable to anyone else in the competition.

Lacking in vitality, force, or conviction; dull.
The team gave a lackluster performance.

Furiously angry.
He was absolutely livid when he heard the news.

Having a rich, sweet taste or smell; sexually attractive.
The cake was moist and luscious.

Luxurious or opulent.
The hotel offered a truly luxe experience.

Excessively concerned with material possessions and wealth.
He became very materialistic after winning the lottery.

relating to or used for navigation
The ship's navigational equipment was state-of-the-art.

having or showing sensitive insight
She is a very perceptive observer of human nature.

carried out as a precaution
They took precautionary steps to avoid any accidents.

tending to calm or soothe
The doctor prescribed a sedative to help the patient relax before surgery.

suffering from a mental or emotional disorder; disrupted
The loud noise from the construction site disturbed his sleep.

having or showing knowledge of a subject or situation
It's important to make an informed decision based on all available facts.

having the necessary financial or practical help
The project was fully supported by the local community.

able to float; cheerful
The boat remained buoyant even in rough seas.

relating to calories or heat
This meal is high in caloric content.

not arranged in a neat or orderly way; suffering from a mental or physical condition
His room was completely disordered after the party.

having no distinct character or identity; anonymous
He felt like just another faceless number in the large corporation.

very cold in temperature; showing no warmth of feeling
The arctic winds made the morning frigid.

involving or showing violence and bloodshed
The movie was too gory for young children to watch.

curious or inquiring
The inquisitive child asked many questions.

providing knowledge or information; educational
The documentary was very instructive about ancient civilizations.

having no meaning; absurd
His explanation was completely nonsensical and didn't make any sense.

appearing or happening on a screen (e.g., television, computer)
The actor's onscreen chemistry with his co-star was undeniable.

on or towards the land from the sea
The company is investing in new onshore wind farms.

after childbirth
She experienced postpartum depression after the baby was born.

involving the second power of an unknown quantity or variable
We are studying quadratic equations in algebra class.

not accompanied by anyone or anything
Children under 12 must not travel unaccompanied.

formed into a legal corporation; included as part of something larger
The company was incorporated last year.

permissible
Only allowable expenses can be claimed on your tax return.

Able to be avoided or prevented.
Many accidents are entirely avoidable if people are careful.

misleading; dishonest.
His deceitful actions led to a loss of trust.

full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness
Her exuberant personality made her popular with everyone.

(of a person or their thoughts and ideas) overimaginative and unrealistic
She had some fanciful ideas about how to solve the problem.

sticky and soft; resembling gum
The candy was very sweet and gummy.

(of a body of water) deep and wide enough for ships to pass through
The river is navigable for small boats for about 50 miles.

feeling or expressing bitterness or indignation at having been treated unfairly
She felt resentful after being overlooked for the promotion.

fulfilling its function adequately; usable
The old car was still serviceable, though not very stylish.

without a bottom; extremely deep; seemingly endless
The children were fascinated by the idea of a bottomless pit.

friendly and welcoming to guests
The locals were very hospitable to the tourists.

Hypnotizing; captivating.
The dancer's performance was absolutely mesmerizing.

Causing an obstruction; uncooperative.
The company was criticized for its obstructive behavior during the investigation.

returning to a former or less developed state
The new tax policy was criticized as regressive.

deserving regret; unfortunate
It was a regrettable mistake that cost them the game.

having the ability to restore health, strength, or a feeling of well-being
A good night's sleep can be very restorative.

dreamy, vague, or eccentric
She seemed a bit spacey after waking up from her nap.

below the usual or required standard
The quality of the work was substandard.

of poor quality; crazy or eccentric
That movie was totally wack, I didn't enjoy it at all.

giving a warning
The teacher gave a cautionary tale about cheating.

happening by chance; accidental
It was purely coincidental that we met at the airport.

waiting eagerly; pregnant
The audience was expectant as the curtain began to rise.

suffering from a hangover
He woke up feeling completely hungover after the party.

not pure; mixed with unwanted substances
The water was impure and not safe to drink.

dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking in variety and interest
The work was monotonous, consisting of repetitive tasks.

having several purposes or functions
We bought a multipurpose tool that can be used for many tasks.

in or toward the north; from the north
A strong northerly wind blew across the plains.

cheerful and lively
Despite the early hour, she was surprisingly perky.

receiving a salary
She preferred a salaried position over hourly work.
